{{Quote|They're desperate, they have no hope of rescue and we share a common enemy. You can mold them like clay.|Hargrev|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>}}
'''Clay''' was used by the [[Schenor]] [[Species/Legends|species]] as a key construction material, together with [[Sandstone/Legends|sandstone]].
